caseName: Hauser ex rel. Crawford v. Moore
caseNameFull: Hauser, by His Next Friends, Crawford v. Moore, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari dismissed. Justice Stevens would grant the application for stay of execution.
